name: Pankhuri Sinha

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pankhuri Sinha writes poetry in Hindi and English as well as short fiction. Hindwi’s author archive links her with Muzaffarpur, Bihar, and lists the story collections Koi Bhee Din and Kissa-e-Kohnoor. She has also taken part in literary conversations across languages, including The Chakkar’s discussion of mother tongues in a global context.

“Serdica Metro Station” layers the movement of a present-day traveller over ancient ruins, gods and armies. Athena, Ares and the memory of a peace agreement enter a scene suddenly interrupted by an arriving train. The poem carries its meditation on war back into daily life, ending with an invitation to return and send messages of peace.
